title: Plux analytics: performance by device class
description: Build time percentiles of render_perf by device class (ANL-020).

list.name: organization
list.label: Organisation ID
list.description: The organisation UUID. Row-level security binds every query to it (SRV-022).

list.name: app
list.label: App
list.description: The apps of the organisation with rollups.

list.name: release
list.label: Release sequence
list.description: The release sequences of the selected apps with rollups.

options.content: **Not shown.** render_perf carries a janky frame percentage, but the rollups keep only the build time (`build_ms`) as the event's value, so jank percentiles cannot be read from `analytics_rollups`. They need a rollup value column (ANL-010).

panels.title: Build time by device class
panels.description: Build time (build_ms of render_perf) per device class. p50, p90 and p99 are the upper edge of the histogram bucket that holds the percentile, so they overstate by at most one bucket. 60000 means 60 s or more.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', ${organization:sqlstring}, false);
WITH hist AS (
  SELECT r.device_class AS grp, u.idx - 1 AS k, SUM(u.n) AS n
  FROM analytics_rollups r
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(r.histogram) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(n, idx)
  WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF(${organization:sqlstring}, '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = ${granularity:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.event_name = 'render_perf'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), cum AS (
  SELECT grp, k,
    SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY k) AS run,
    SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY grp) AS total
  FROM hist
), edges AS (
  SELECT grp,
    MIN(k) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.50 * total) AS p50,
    MIN(k) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.90 * total) AS p90,
    MIN(k) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.99 * total) AS p99
  FROM cum
  GROUP BY grp
), totals AS (
  SELECT r.device_class AS grp, SUM(r.value_count) AS samples,
    SUM(r.value_sum) / NULLIF(SUM(r.value_count), 0) AS mean, MAX(r.value_max) AS max
  FROM analytics_rollups r
  WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF(${organization:sqlstring}, '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = ${granularity:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.event_name = 'render_perf'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT t.grp AS "Device class", t.samples AS "Samples", ROUND(t.mean) AS "Mean (ms)",
  (ARRAY[1,2,5,10,20,50,100,200,500,1000,2000,5000,10000,30000,60000])[LEAST(e.p50 + 1, 15)] AS "p50 (ms)",
  (ARRAY[1,2,5,10,20,50,100,200,500,1000,2000,5000,10000,30000,60000])[LEAST(e.p90 + 1, 15)] AS "p90 (ms)",
  (ARRAY[1,2,5,10,20,50,100,200,500,1000,2000,5000,10000,30000,60000])[LEAST(e.p99 + 1, 15)] AS "p99 (ms)",
  t.max AS "Max (ms)"
FROM totals t
LEFT JOIN edges e ON e.grp = t.grp
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Build time p90 by device class
panels.description: The p90 build time per bucket, one series per device class. Same bucket-edge caveat as the table.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', ${organization:sqlstring}, false);
WITH hist AS (
  SELECT r.bucket, r.device_class AS grp, u.idx - 1 AS k, SUM(u.n) AS n
  FROM analytics_rollups r
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(r.histogram) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(n, idx)
  WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF(${organization:sqlstring}, '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = ${granularity:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.event_name = 'render_perf'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
), cum AS (
  SELECT bucket, grp, k,
    SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY bucket, grp ORDER BY k) AS run,
    SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY bucket, grp) AS total
  FROM hist
)
SELECT bucket AS time, grp AS metric,
  (ARRAY[1,2,5,10,20,50,100,200,500,1000,2000,5000,10000,30000,60000])[LEAST(MIN(k) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.9 * total) + 1, 15)] AS "p90"
FROM cum
GROUP BY bucket, grp
ORDER BY 1;
